peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 6.9% below its local comparables; 10 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (39.1): 2.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 21 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,494,000 ($1,599 psf, 925–947 sq ft; 12 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,717 psf (range $1,642–1,825); 6.9% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $110,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Sep 2023 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 4 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Havelock MRT about 390 m, Great World MRT about 420 m; closer than 16 of 63 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 650 m; more than 55 of 63 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 370 m), more than 45 of 63 similar developments (the same as 5); nearest hawker centre Havelock Road Cooked Food Centre about 240 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 570 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 380 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 400 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 630 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 630 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 870 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,100 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,220 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 1,270 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 261 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,418 new sales and 1,043 resales (2,461 purchases); new sales were 57.6% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,043 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 60 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,043 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,226 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.9%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
